verdict.rationale: Postmark documents a batch send endpoint (`/email/batch`) and a batch-with-templates endpoint (`/email/batchWithTemplates`), so many personalized messages can go out in one API request instead of one call per recipient. However, the evidence never documents per-message status in the batch response. The only per-recipient MessageID and error example uses a `Promise.allSettled` pattern, which suggests parallel calls rather than a single batch response. missing for 10: documented per-message status/error array in the batch response, batch size limits, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can send a batch of personalized emails in a single API request with per-message status in the response, instead of looping one call per recipient
